the_problem.title: Why Raw HTML and Downscaled Screenshots Blind AI Models
the_problem.summary: Standard LLM toolkits provide agents with low-fidelity approximations that force models to hallucinate layout dimensions and read codebases through unindexed string search.

flawed_approach.title: Uncomputed HTML & Vision Screenshots
points: Raw DOM text omits computed CSS cascade, box-model rects, and render coordinates.
Screenshots compressed to 1024px blur micro-typography, subpixel padding, and borders.
Vision models cannot mathematically measure WCAG contrast ratios or 8pt grid alignment.

prism_solution.title: Deterministic Headless Layout Extraction
points: Extracts real computed values directly from Chromium layout engine.
Generates 2D ASCII spatial radars and exact box models: padding, margin, bounds.
Computes exact WCAG AAA color contrast ratios and flags layer occlusion collisions.

flawed_approach.title: Full-File Dumps & Naive Grep
points: Dumping entire files burns thousands of context tokens and triggers attention drift.
Text regex cannot trace AST relationships, inheritance, or route decorators.
Agents cannot deduce which source file produced a rendered DOM element.

prism_solution.title: AST Symbol Indexing & Line-Sliced Retrieval
points: Fast tree-sitter AST parser extracts function signatures, classes, and exported routes.
get_file delivers line-sliced fragments with line numbers, eliminating context pollution.
find_ui_source correlates rendered DOM tags and text directly to JSX/TSX source lines.

architecture.title: Tri-Core Intelligence Pipeline
architecture.description: Prism operates as a high-throughput bridge connecting external AI agents to deterministic web runtime and AST repository indexes.

pipeline_steps.name: MCP Transport Layer
pipeline_steps.description: Exposes standard Model Context Protocol tools to agents like Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw, with zero agent-side modifications.

pipeline_steps.name: Web Inspection Pipeline
pipeline_steps.description: Navigates target URLs, evaluates computed styles, runs WCAG audits, computes 2D spatial radars, and renders vector wireframe SVGs.

pipeline_steps.name: Correlation & Verification Engine
pipeline_steps.description: Maps rendered selectors to code lines with find_ui_source, and computes differential layout regressions across state transitions with verify_change.

pipeline_steps.name: AST Repository Pipeline
pipeline_steps.description: Indexes symbols, maps caller/callee graphs, calculates blast radius up to depth 3 with trace_impact, and provides line-sliced surgical code slices.

tools_matrix.title: 13 Model Context Protocol Tools
tools_matrix.description: Categorized tools exposed via JSON-RPC stdio, Server-Sent Events, and REST.

tools.name: inspect_website
tools.description: Extracts full layout tree, computed box models, design tokens, WCAG contrast audits, and vector wireframe SVGs.

tools.name: inspect_page
tools.description: Inspects the active session app with token-efficient output options for iterative agent loops.

tools.name: capture_screenshots
tools.description: Captures synchronized dual viewports: Desktop (1440x900) and Mobile (390x844).

tools.name: find_ui_source
tools.description: Correlates rendered DOM nodes directly to JSX/TSX components and exact line numbers.

tools.name: verify_change
tools.description: Compares layout states before and after code edits, validating resolved bugs and flagging layout regressions.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Unified token-efficient payload combining element bounding box, layout defects, source candidates, and blast radius.

tools.name: connect_project
tools.description: Binds a local repository path to a running application URL to maintain an active inspection session.

tools.name: index_repository
tools.description: Performs ephemeral repository acquisition, parses AST symbols, builds file trees, and extracts routes.

tools.name: search_codebase
tools.description: Executes structural AST searches for functions, classes, interfaces, and API endpoints.

tools.name: get_file
tools.output: Line-sliced source text with numbered prefixes
tools.description: Surgically retrieves precise file line ranges (e.g. lines 40-75) without polluting context with full files.

tools.name: trace_symbol
tools.description: Traces definitions, direct importers, re-exports, callers, callees, and route handlers for a target symbol.

tools.name: trace_impact
tools.description: Calculates direct and transitive blast radius, affected HTTP endpoints, and assign risk levels (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH).

tools.name: explain_architecture
tools.description: Summarizes tech stack, package dependencies, main entry points, and structural directory taxonomy.

ecosystem.title: Native Support for 70+ AI Agents
ecosystem.description: Standardized on the open Model Context Protocol and Agent Skills specification. Configured automatically with the universal installer.

chatgpt_actions.title: ChatGPT Custom Actions on Mobile & Web
chatgpt_actions.description: Use Prism from iOS, Android, or chatgpt.com using OpenAPI 3.0 Custom Actions.

install_methods.name: One-Line Universal Installer (Recommended)
install_methods.note: Interactively prompts for Global vs Project scope and auto-detects all installed AI coding agents.

install_methods.name: Non-Interactive / CI Installation
install_methods.note: Installs globally for all detected coding agents automatically.

install_methods.name: Manual Git Clone & Local Build
install_methods.snippet:
git clone https://github.com/whysooraj/prism.git ~/.prism
cd ~/.prism
npm install
npm run build
install_methods.note: Compile from source and register 'node ~/.prism/dist/index.js' in your agent's MCP config.
